**Frame:** Full-width black title panel. The title is dirty off-white; `ZZ` carries the quiet moss accent established by the board. No logo, robot, or network spectacle.

**Action:** The incident movement resolves into the title.

**Screen / system text:**
`ZZ: NO CONSUMER`

**Provenance:** `invented` — title treatment is project design, derived from the documented [page-003](003.md) string.
